name: Rage
description: Enter a rage if you aren't wearing Heavy armor. While raging: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; +2 bonus to Strength-based attack damage; Advantage on Strength checks and saves; you can't maintain Concentration or cast spells. It lasts until the end of your next turn unless you extend it by attacking, forcing a save, or taking a Bonus Action — up to 10 minutes.
